summary: Sotera Health Co filed an 8-K announcing Amendment No. 7 to its First Lien Credit Agreement, refinancing $1,415.9 million in term loans with a 0.25% interest rate reduction to SOFR + 2.25% and a 1.00% soft call premium for six months. The transaction is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. No change of control, tender offer, or strategic transaction is involved. Risk-arb watch is not applicable.
